faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I register my business?
faq.a1: Choose "Register your business", create an account and complete the business profile.
faq.q2: Does it cost anything to join during the pilot?
faq.a2: During the pilot, the first 100 businesses receive free access for one year. Any paid offering later will be communicated clearly before it applies.
faq.q3: When will my profile be published?
faq.a3: Business profiles are reviewed before publication. Processing time may vary.
faq.q4: Can I edit the profile after publication?
faq.a4: Yes. You can update your business information from the dashboard at any time.

intro.heading: 1. Who is responsible
intro.p1: This privacy policy describes how DinLinks processes personal data in the service.
intro.p2: DinLinks is operated by Ahmed Hasan, who is the controller for the processing described in this privacy policy. Questions about privacy and requests regarding your rights can be sent to privacy@dinlinks.com.

dataCollection.heading: 2. What information we process
dataCollection.intro: We process these categories of information:
dataCollection.item1: Account information, such as name and email address
dataCollection.item2: Information related to sign-in and account security
dataCollection.item3: The business profile the owner fills in
dataCollection.item4: Enquiries you send us by email
dataCollection.item5: Technical information generated when using the service, such as IP address and browser information, where relevant for operation and security
dataCollection.item6: Subscription and payment related information, only if payment functionality is actually used

dataUse.heading: 3. Why we process it, and legal basis
dataUse.intro: The purpose determines which legal basis applies:
dataUse.item1: Creating and operating your account, giving access to the business profile and delivering the functionality you ask for. Basis: contract, GDPR Article 6(1)(b).
dataUse.item2: Keeping the platform secure, preventing abuse and fraud, keeping the service reliable and answering ordinary enquiries. Basis: legitimate interests, GDPR Article 6(1)(f). The interest is keeping the service safe and running for everyone who uses it.
dataUse.item3: Meeting obligations that follow from law, where the processing is necessary for that. Basis: legal obligation, GDPR Article 6(1)(c).
dataUse.item4: Where we ask you to consent to something specific, consent is the basis for that processing only. Consent can be withdrawn at any time.

dataSharing.heading: 4. Sharing and service providers
dataSharing.intro: DinLinks does not sell personal data. To operate the service we use providers in these categories:
dataSharing.item4: Payment provider, if payment functionality is used
dataSharing.item5: Public authorities or advisers, where we are required to disclose information
dataSharing.outro: Providers receive only the information necessary for the task they carry out.

transfers.heading: 5. Transfers outside Norway and the EEA
transfers.text: Some of our providers may process information outside Norway and the EEA. Where that happens, the transfer relies on a valid transfer mechanism under the GDPR, for example an adequacy decision or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

retention.heading: 6. How long we keep information
retention.intro: We keep information for as long as it is necessary for the purpose it was collected for:
retention.item1: Account and profile data: while the account is active, and afterwards only where necessary for legitimate or legal reasons
retention.item2: Enquiries: as long as necessary to handle and document the enquiry
retention.item3: Technical and security data: for a limited period necessary for operation, troubleshooting and security
retention.item4: Information we are required to keep: for the period the law requires
retention.outro: When information is no longer necessary it is deleted or anonymised, unless retention is required by law.

cookies.heading: 7. Cookies and similar technology
cookies.intro: DinLinks uses technology that is necessary for the service to work, including for:
cookies.item1: Sign-in and keeping you signed in
cookies.outro: DinLinks does not use advertising cookies and does not track you across websites for marketing.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.item1: Access the information we process about you
rights.item5: Receive the information in a machine-readable format, where the right to data portability applies
rights.item6: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
rights.item7: Withdraw consent, where consent is the basis
rights.outro: Requests can be sent to privacy@dinlinks.com. You can also complain to Datatilsynet, the Norwegian Data Protection Authority, if you believe the processing breaches the rules.

automated.heading: 9. Automated decisions
automated.text: DinLinks does not make decisions about you that are based solely on automated processing and that produce legal effects or similarly significant effects. Business profiles are reviewed by a person before publication.

security.heading: 10. Security
security.text: DinLinks uses appropriate technical and organisational safeguards to protect information. If you suspect a security issue, you can report it to security@dinlinks.com.

contact.heading: 11. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can contact us at

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.text: By using DinLinks ("the service") you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the service.

usage.heading: 2. Use of the service
usage.p1: You agree to use the service only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of, or restrict or inhibit the use of the service by any other party.
usage.p2: You must not use the service in any way that could damage, disable, overburden, or impair the service, or interfere with any other party's use of the service.

accounts.heading: 3. User accounts
accounts.intro: To access certain features of the service, you may be required to create an account. You agree to:
accounts.item1: Provide accurate, complete, and current information
accounts.item2: Maintain the security of your password
accounts.item3: Immediately notify us of unauthorised use of your account

profiles.heading: 4. Business profiles
profiles.intro: If you register a business profile, you agree:
profiles.item1: That all information you provide is true and accurate
profiles.item2: That you have the right to represent the business
profiles.item3: That you will keep the information up to date
profiles.item4: That the profile may be reviewed before approval

ip.heading: 5. Intellectual property
ip.text: The service and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by DinLinks and are protected by Norwegian and international copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and other intellectual property laws.

disclaimer.heading: 6. Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without any form of warranty. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free.

liability.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
liability.text: DinLinks shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, use, or other intangible losses.

changes.heading: 8. Changes to terms
changes.text: We reserve the right to change these terms at any time. We will notify you of changes by publishing the new terms on this page.

contact.heading: 9. Contact us
contact.text: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at
